newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close higher, led by forestry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close higher, led by forestry.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket closed higher on Friday, reversing morning losses in afternoon trade, led up by the forestry sector and cyclical stocks.
The Stockholm general index climbed 0.48 percent to 2149.67 after shares worth 3.8 billion crowns changed hands with the market buoyed by a higher open on Wall Street.
Brokers said the market was playing "follow-the-leader" and the main focus remained nine-month reports due out next week.
The strongest sector on Friday was forestry which rose 1.89 percent. Stora rose 3.50 crowns to 89.50 and MoDo was 5.5 higher at 186.50 crowns.
Bluechip stocks gained. Telecoms giant Ericsson, forecast to post a 29 percent higher nine month profit next Tuesday, rose two to 184.5 crowns.

Drugs major Astra closed three higher at 309.5 crowns. Fellow drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn climbed seven to 249.50 crowns, in line with New York performance, pulling the drugs sector index up 1.14 percent.
Mining group Trellebrog posted a weaker-than-expected nine month profit and lost ground initially but recovered to close one crown higher at 88 crowns.
